text: Broker David Smith and Shelton Medical Centre are completely mutually dependent — 100 percent of his referrals, 100 percent of its claims — they share a registered address, and the pair sits alone in one small payment community. The transfers to the broker match expected commission almost exactly, so this is not a hidden-money case; it is a total-capture case: one broker constitutes this clinic's entire existence, at the same address. Exclusive partnerships are the honest FP mode for this rule, which caps how far the score climbs without excess payments — but exclusivity this absolute, plus co-location, is a structural red flag worth an investigator's time regardless. Note the same clinic appears separately in the queue as a high-severity ghost-clinic alert; read the two together. Next step: treat the ghost-clinic alert as primary and this pairing as its distribution mechanism.
